{
  "question": "For Alto Airways, what do the latest records show about passenger load factor? Please resolve this specific point: September passenger load factor from revenue passenger kilometres and available seat kilometres.",

  "passages": [
    "I began with the underlying record, then checked the units against the stated scope of the exercise.

A flight-school article calls pilot workload a load factor.

Background to the observation: Alto added flights to its eastern network in September.

A comparison should use the same unit on both sides. A percentage-point change is different from a percentage change. A nameplate limit is also different from measured delivery under operating conditions.

SYNTHETIC benchmark article. People, records and quantities in this standalone research fixture are invented."
  ]
}
